== Template:Item/Resists ==

Displays the resistance modifiers section of an item tooltip (Magic/Poison/Elemental/Void).

=== Parameters ===

{| class="wikitable"
! Parameter !! Default !! Description
|-
| '''magic''' || 0 || Magic resistance modifier (percentage)
|-
| '''poison''' || 0 || Poison resistance modifier (percentage)
|-
| '''elemental''' || 0 || Elemental resistance modifier (percentage)
|-
| '''void''' || 0 || Void resistance modifier (percentage)
|}

=== Example ===

'''Code:'''
<pre>
{{Item/Resists
|magic=5
|poison=10
|elemental=3
|void=8
}}
</pre>

'''Result:'''

{{Item/Resists
|magic=5
|poison=10
|elemental=3
|void=8
}}

----
